Krash is one of the main characters in KikoRiki (also known as GoGoRiki or Smeshariki in different regions). He's a young blue rabbit who is approximately 8 years old in the series. He's known for his curious and scientific nature, often conducting experiments and sharing interesting facts with his friends. Krash attends school with the other young characters and is particularly close friends with Chiko, the scientific hedgehog who mentors him.

In the later seasons of the show, Krash turns 10, which is celebrated in a special episode where he receives his first chemistry set. The show's creators deliberately made him this age to help young viewers relate to his learning experiences and adventures. In the spin-off series "Pin-Code," Krash is shown to be 11 years old and takes on more advanced scientific projects under the guidance of local inventors.
